description: Trigger: in peering/pipeline.rs run_pipeline(), a block is written to IPFS successfully, then sqlx INSERT into msgid_map fails (DB lock, constraint error, etc.). Bad behavior: the IPFS block exists with no articles table row and no GC tracking entry. The block is never GC'd (no pinned_cids row, no articles row), leaking storage indefinitely. The message-ID cannot be served, but the CID remains pinned and occupies IPFS storage forever.
title: run_pipeline orphans IPFS block when msgid_map insert fails
